whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Samrat Fitness,

I noticed your gym has exceptional 4.9★ ratings with 600+ reviews in Khemnichak, Patna, but your digital booking and membership flow could be much faster for mobile users.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, transparent package pricing (Daily Pass to Platinum), aur trainer profiles integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/samratfitness

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Saurya / Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Samrat Fitness Gym) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with advanced biomechanics equipment highlights, transparent membership tiers, and direct WhatsApp trial booking for Patna fitness seekers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
